content.overview: Section 253, which provided for determination of a company as a sick company, was omitted. Sick-company revival under Chapter XIX is not current law.
content.glance: Section 253, which provided for determination of a company as a sick company, was omitted. Sick-company revival under Chapter XIX is not current law.
content.study: Chapter XIX (sections 253 to 269) dealt with revival and rehabilitation of sick companies. Those sections were omitted by the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (Second Amendment) framework and the related repeal notification; they are not the current route for corporate distress. Current corporate insolvency resolution and liquidation of corporate persons is under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, before the National Company Law Tribunal as adjudicating authority. A study note that treats s. 253 as available current procedure is wrong. The topic is retained so the omitted number is not mistaken for a gap in the Act.
